about.text: A kefir drink from Chile, made by fermenting milk with kefir grains of household origin from the Valparaíso Region, then separating the drink from the grains by percolation. In the study, 10 g of grains went into 100 mL of UHT milk, incubated for 48 hours at 25 °C.

sources.text: The grains and how the drink is made, from this paper.
